run.question: Three days ago, on 2026-11-20 between 15:15 and 16:15 UTC, our billing service logged errors during invoice export. Search the Elasticsearch index cp1-billing-logs for ERROR entries from service billing in that window and tell me what failed and how many errors there were.

report.summary: The requested window, 2026-11-20T15:15:00Z to 2026-11-20T16:15:00Z, lies outside this Run's authorized window (2026-11-22T15:17:07Z to 2026-11-23T15:17:07Z), so the Elasticsearch search for it was refused with INVALID_PARAMS / QUERY_OUT_OF_WINDOW and no documents from that date were read. The index cp1-billing-logs does exist and is reachable: health green, 60 documents, mapping @timestamp (date), level (keyword), message (text), service (keyword). Inside the authorized window only, 20 documents matched for service billing, timestamped 2026-11-23T14:17:11Z through 2026-11-23T15:14:11Z, and every one of those 20 was level INFO with no ERROR bucket in the level aggregation — that describes 2026-11-23, not the 2026-11-20 window the question asks about, and the ERROR-only query run in the authorized window returned an empty (no_data) result. So nothing here establishes what failed during invoice export on 2026-11-20 or how many errors there were; the count is unknown and no root cause is identified.

claims.text: The index cp1-billing-logs exists and is reachable: health green, status open, docs.count 60, store.size 10.3kb, and its mapping defines @timestamp (date), level (keyword), message (text) and service (keyword).

Within the authorized window 2026-11-22T15:17:07Z to 2026-11-23T15:17:07Z, the query over cp1-billing-logs matched 20 documents whose @timestamp range is 2026-11-23T14:17:11Z to 2026-11-23T15:14:11Z; the level aggregation contains only a single bucket level=INFO with doc_count 20 (sum_other_doc_count 0) and the service aggregation only service=billing with doc_count 20. This is a different date than the 2026-11-20 window asked about.
Of the index's 60 documents, only 20 fall inside the authorized window, so 40 of the 60 documents lie outside it; their timestamps, levels and messages were not readable in this Run.

Rejected as an answer to the question: the 20-document, all-INFO sample retrieved for 2026-11-23T14:17:11Z–2026-11-23T15:14:11Z cannot be treated as the 2026-11-20 invoice-export error population; the query window differs and the query is filtered to 2026-11-23 only.
